limitations: Single-process screens do not establish repeatable gains.
Request positions and every startup/return observation are preserved; model/profile load is outside request time.
The system file cache is not reset between processes; reverse ordering reduces but does not eliminate order bias.
CPU NF4-Q8 changes arithmetic; model quality acceptance is independent of real greedy continuation.
Complementary host sources can change CPU/GPU placement and generated routing.
CPU compute/join may overlap supply/GPU work; these durations must not be added as exclusive costs.
Byte counters are submitted payloads, not measured PCIe throughput.
Host-pool misses exclude direct staging reads when the persistent host pool is disabled.
Source prefetch bytes are advisory requests; touch pages count range visits, not unique OS faults.
Source prefetch/touch time is included in cold queue and may overlap GPU work; compute excludes it.
Ordinary traces show host ordering/ownership, not pure GPU execution or overlap.
CPU cache copies only original packed bytes; nested metadata still borrows original mapping.
CPU cache is pageable anonymous memory, not locked or guaranteed physically resident.
Independent offline profile excludes only initial GPU hot tier; later ready adoption may overlap it.
Initialization copying is outside request timing and its duration/bytes remain recorded.
Expanded host pool stays zero; added CPU cache has a separate explicit RAM budget.

excluded.reason: PowerShell native -File string-array argument binding rejected before GPU launch; corrected with an array in a driver script.
Guard harness compared slash spelling to a Windows-normalized Path, so synthetic replacement was not applied; fixed Path equality, final guards passed.

Source-capture helper snapshots C++ sources but does not archive the CLI; bundle rejected the missing Stage2 CLI archive. Current unchanged CLI hash was verified against the pre-measurement source manifest, then archived and revalidated.

limitations: Cache is bounded pageable CPU heap, separate from expanded host pool and USM ledger; no physical-residency guarantee.
Packed NF4 byte copies retain original nested scale and LUT metadata; CPU NF4-Q8 approximation is unchanged.
Static initialization cost is outside request timing and explicitly logged; prompt refill is inside request timing.
Prompt refresh only consumes completed prefill route counts, excludes current Ready/Copying GPU experts, and drains CPU readers first.
Cache payload arena stays fixed at prompt boundaries; unchanged expert copies retain their original slots.
Short single-process screens cannot establish repeatable gains; negative prompt screens were not promoted or pooled with formal runs.
Original model bytes are not hashed in full; the existing sampled identity and exact same model configuration/profile guards remain.
GPU exact-row proof covers first prefill and next47 decode logits; CPU mode2 is checked by KL/NRMSE and original-mapped bitwise CPU shadows.
live_usm_delta=0 is the existing device/pinned USM lifecycle check, not accounting for the separate pageable CPU cache.
Windows file cache is not reset, reverse round2 reduces order bias; process faults or WDDM paging causality were not measured here.
